name: Archer Pull-Up
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with a very wide overhand grip.
Pull yourself up towards one hand, bending that arm while the other stays almost straight along the bar.
Lower yourself under control and repeat, alternating the sides or finishing one side first.

name: Back Lever
instructions: Hang from a bar or rings, tuck the knees and rotate backwards through the arms (skin the cat) until you hang face down behind them.
Extend the body until it is straight and horizontal, face down, with the arms straight.
Hold for the time set, then bring the knees back in and rotate out.

name: Burpees
instructions: Stand up, then squat and place your hands on the floor.
Jump the feet back into a plank and do a push-up.
Jump the feet back to the hands, then jump up with the arms overhead; land softly and repeat.

name: Chest-to-Bar Pull-Up
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip, hands a little wider than the shoulders.
Pull yourself up, leading with the chest, until the chest touches the bar; keep the shoulders down and the body tight.
Lower yourself under control to a full hang and repeat.

name: Chest-to-Wall Handstand Hold
instructions: Place your hands on the floor a short step from a wall and walk the feet up the wall until the body is straight and the chest faces it.
Push the floor away, keep the arms locked, the ribs in and the body in one line.
Hold for the time set, then walk the feet down.

name: Dead Hang
instructions: Grab a pull-up bar with an overhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart.
Let the body hang with straight arms and the feet off the floor, breathing calmly.
Hold for the time set, then step down.

name: Dragon Flag
instructions: Lie on a bench and grip it behind your head.
Lift the whole body, straight from the shoulders to the feet, until it points upwards, resting only on the upper back.
Lower the straight body slowly until it almost touches the bench, then raise it again and repeat.

name: Frog Stand
instructions: Squat down and place your hands flat on the floor, shoulder-width apart, fingers spread.
Rest the knees on the backs of the upper arms, near the elbows, and lean forward until the feet lift off the floor.
Hold the balance with the arms bent and the gaze slightly forward for the time set, then lower the feet.

name: Front Lever
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip and straight arms.
Pull the bar down towards the hips and raise the straight body until it is horizontal, face up.
Hold for the time set, then lower the legs under control.

name: Full Bridge
instructions: Lie on your back with the knees bent, the feet flat near the hips and the hands by the ears, fingers towards the shoulders.
Push through the hands and feet to lift the hips and the head off the floor, straightening the arms as far as you can.
Hold for the time set, breathing calmly, then lower yourself slowly, head first.

name: Hollow Body Hold
instructions: Lie on your back with the arms overhead and the legs straight.
Press the lower back into the floor and lift the shoulders and the legs a few centimetres off it, so the body forms a shallow curve.
Hold for the time set without letting the lower back lift.

name: Ice Cream Maker
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip.
Pull yourself up; at the top, lean back and push the bar towards the hips while raising the straight body to horizontal, as in a front lever.
Swing the body back under the bar into the top of the pull-up, lower yourself under control and repeat.

name: L-Sit
instructions: Sit between two parallel bars, two handles or on the floor, with the hands next to the hips.
Press down with straight arms to lift the body, and raise the straight legs in front until they are level with the hips.
Hold for the time set, shoulders down, then lower yourself.

name: L-Sit Pull-Up
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar and raise your straight legs in front of you until they are level with the hips, forming an L.
Keeping the legs up, pull yourself up until the chin is over the bar.
Lower yourself under control without dropping the legs, and repeat.

name: Pike Push-Up
instructions: Start in a push-up position, then walk the feet towards the hands and lift the hips until the body forms an upside-down V.
Bend the elbows to lower the top of the head towards the floor between the hands.
Push back up to straight arms and repeat.

name: Shoulder Dislocates
instructions: Hold a stick or a band in front of the hips with a wide overhand grip.
With straight arms, raise it over the head and carry it behind the back as far as the hips.
Bring it back to the front the same way and repeat; narrow the grip as the shoulders loosen.

name: Shoulder Opener Stretch
instructions: Kneel and place your hands on a bench, a chair or the floor in front of you, arms straight and shoulder-width apart.
Sink the chest down between the arms, keeping the hips above the knees, until you feel the stretch in the shoulders.
Hold for the time set, breathing deeply.

name: Skin the Cat
instructions: Hang from a bar or rings with straight arms.
Tuck the knees and rotate backwards, passing the legs between the arms, until you hang behind them in a German hang as far as the shoulders allow.
Rotate back the same way to the hang and repeat.

name: Toes-to-Bar
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip.
Tighten the abdominals and raise the legs until the toes touch the bar.
Lower the legs under control, without swinging, and repeat.

name: Tuck Planche
instructions: Place your hands on the floor or on parallettes, shoulder-width apart, fingers turned slightly out.
Lean forward over the hands with straight arms and lift the feet, keeping the knees tucked to the chest and the back rounded.
Hold for the time set, then lower the feet.

name: Two-Arm Kettlebell Swing
instructions: Stand with the feet a little wider than the hips and hold a kettlebell with both hands, arms straight.
Hinge at the hips, letting the kettlebell swing back between the legs, then drive the hips forward to swing it to chest height.
Let it fall back into the next swing, keeping the back flat, and repeat.
